name: Satou Reiko
source:
A self-proclaimed ojou-sama who is fixated on ruining the reputations of different academies for some unkown reason. A very popular person despite her dominant laughter and mannerisms.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
translation:
自称大小姐，不知为何执着于破坏各所学园的名声。尽管笑声和举止颇具支配性，她仍是非常受欢迎的人。

[来源：[url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
